persona: HR operations executive who moved into Employee Central configuration
resumeText:
Priya Raghavan | Hyderabad | priya.raghavan@example.com

EXPERIENCE

- Loaded employee data through import templates and fixed validation errors before cutover.

- Supported HR users during user acceptance testing and logged defects.

HR Operations Executive, Sunrise Retail, Hyderabad (2020 - 2023)
- Maintained employee master data in SAP HCM for 3,000 store staff.
- Answered employee queries on payroll and leave.

SKILLS
SuccessFactors Employee Central, Integration Center, Excel

EDUCATION
MBA Human Resources, Osmania University, 2020
